verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents real-time webhooks that need a 200 response to confirm delivery, plus stable event IDs for handling retries idempotently. The web app lets you inspect delivery status (success, queued or failed) and re-deliver events after downtime, which covers retries, event logs and replay. However, the evidence never mentions payload signing or signature verification, and the automatic retry policy is only implied. Missing for 10: documented webhook signature/HMAC verification, an explicit automatic retry schedule, API-level event log/replay access, and independent hands-on corroboration.
